answer: Pay accounts that move in lockstep as one payee. At each close the node scores every pair of answering accounts on two signals: submit times within 3 seconds of each other, and 5-gram text overlap above 0.4. A pair that trips both in 4 of the last 8 epochs is merged and splits a single reward. The close report lists merged rows in jade and cleared rows in marble, so anyone can audit it. A farm of 1,000 keys run by one script drops to its nadir, one payout, while honest agents on their own clocks rarely trip both.
